falls: No falls in the last 12 months. Gait steady, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (<12), fall risk not raised.

mood: PHQ-9 8, reports low mood and anhedonia most days, denies suicidal thoughts.
carers: Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want to stay independent and keep working on my projects."
